thread:
Alex: Heads-up — Product wants to pilot a small Dedicated tenant with a new vendor GPU pool. Need quick checks before we sign anything.
Priya: which vendor / region / target instance class?
Alex: vendor: GPUCloudX (sent pricing). region: us-east-2. start with rtx6000-equivalent (16GB) for dev + a single higher-tier pool later.
Josh: do we have a bake process for their base images? we usually enforce our golden AMI with nvidia-driver 535 + cuda 12.3. vendor images sometimes break our mount scripts.
Mika: also confirm preemptibility windows and spot behavior. If nodes are evicted frequently, we need routing/fallback to hosted for critical paths.
Priya: for AMI: can the vendor provide a base image with systemd, cloud-init and SSH key injection? If yes we can bake on top; otherwise we should bake from their snapshot. Alex, want infra to bake?
Alex: prefer us to bake so we control drivers/kernel modules. Infra team — can we spin a test instance?
Josh: quick terraform snippet I used for similar vendors:
```
resource "gpucloudx_instance" "test" {
  region = "us-east-2"
  type   = "g-rtx6000"
  image  = "ami-base-v1"
  tags   = ["redwood-infra", "onboarding-test"]
}
```
Josh: adjust the provider creds to the vendor token.
infra-bot: deploy started for test instance (id: gcx-i-0a1b2c3d) — logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/1824512345
Priya: quick update: ran our bake, driver installed but nv-peer memory allocation failed on cuda 12.3 — kernel module needed. Will try driver 535.86 and re-run.
Josh: ping @Mika for pricing approval — if we do reserved the economics change and procurement needs to sign.
Mika: rough calc: 6mo reserved saves ~18% vs on-demand; 1yr ~25%. Agree start small burstable pool then decide.
Alex: ask vendor for a short trial invoice and SLA PDF. Also we need a quota increase request for us-east-2 to the cloud team.
Priya: opening cloud-quota ticket now. Ticket: Q-34211. Adding notes about instance classes and test start date.
Josh: will add AMI bake job to CI (.circleci/bake-gpu-ami.yml) and open PR.
Alex: timeline: test bake + driver fix by Thu EOD, procurement decision Fri. blockers?
Priya: need vendor SSH access to their image snapshot so we can inspect /var and cloud-init logs. @vendor-connect can you share?
vendor-connect: shared key via DM and posted secure link for the image snapshot :lock: — let me know if you can't access.
infra-bot: ticket Q-34211 updated: temporary quota bumped to 12 GPUs in us-east-2 until 2026-06-30.
Mika: sweet — please paste final cost calc in the ticket before Friday and tag me. I'll approve reserved commit if numbers look sane. :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks all — I'll follow up with a checklist in the ticket: bake result, driver version, eviction test, SLA PDF, cost calc.
Priya: quick note — if driver 535.86 still fails, fallback plan is to pin cuda 11.8 for now and re-evaluate.
Josh: fine by me. creating PR for CI bake and adding a small smoke test that runs nvidia-smi + simple tensor allocation.
Alex: perfect. closing for now, will update when the bake completes.
__notes: Generated slack thread: cloud/vendor GPU onboarding coordination — short, realistic messages. No title as per agents.md.
